text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One, a true Tokyo local who 
transferred in from Oi. Though those 
around her view her with prejudice due to 
her unconventional background, she shows 
her determination to silence them with her 
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal: to hold the greatest festival on 
the grandest stage of the Twinkle Series, 
stand at its center, and declare, "Inari 
One is here!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her rivals are her generation-mates, Super 
Creek and Oguri Cap. She eagerly awaits 
the day all three of them can put on one 
spectacular festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tatami mats have been brought into the 
Trainer's office, fully prepared. The 
once-in-a-lifetime grand brawl— the 
Twinkle Series' grand festival begins!
